title: Shared review for shopping list practicality tweaks
description: Perform final cross-cutting review of the implementation, tests, and docs to confirm the feature matches spec scope, preserves existing shopping-list behavior, and avoids misleading UX or persistence regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Review confirms each developer bead satisfied its acceptance criteria and stayed within scope.
Review checks that shared tests and documentation cover the intended behavior changes and note any residual risk.
Review confirms dependency-sensitive behavior: manual aisle overrides are preserved, decorative row affordance is removed cleanly, and compact-mode persistence/propagation align with the spec.
